title: Past Continuous
en:
was / were + -ing — an action in progress at a moment in the past: At 10 o'clock I was checking the invoices.

Often with a short Past Simple action that interrupts it: I was writing the report when the director called.

while + Past Continuous: While we were having lunch, the system crashed.

For background in stories: It was raining and people were waiting for the bus.
ru: was / were + -ing — действие в процессе в момент в прошлом. Длинное действие (Past Continuous) прерывается коротким (Past Simple): I was working when he called. While + Past Continuous.

boss.situation: Describe a day at work when something unexpected happened. What were people doing when it happened?
samples: Last Tuesday I was preparing a report.
My colleagues were having a meeting.
While we were waiting, the manager called the IT team.
When the lights came back, everyone was talking about it.

qs.q: I ___ a shower when the phone rang.
What ___ you doing at 8 pm yesterday?
qs.exp: Past Continuous question → were you doing.

qs.q: While she ___, I cooked dinner.
They ___ when I came in.
When the fire alarm ___, we left the building.
It ___ when we left the office.
He ___ on the phone all morning.
I didn't hear you. I ___ to music.
qs.exp: In progress at that moment → was listening.

qs.q: In “I was reading when he arrived”, the reading started before he arrived.
qs.exp: Continuous action was already in progress.

qs.q: “When I was arriving, they were starting the meeting” is the best way to say it.
qs.exp: Short actions → Past Simple: When I arrived, they started…

qs.q: At 9 o'clock we ___ (check) the documents.
a: were checking

qs.q: She ___ (drive) to work when she saw the accident.
a: was driving

qs.q: What were you ___ (do) when I called?
a: doing

qs.q: The phone rang while I ___ (have) lunch.
a: was having

qs.q: They ___ (not / work) at that time.
a: weren't working
were not working

qs.q: When the manager came in, everybody ___ (talk).
a: was talking

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i was writing an email when the boss called

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: what were you doing at ten

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: while we were waiting the lights went off

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she was not listening to the presentation

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: it was snowing when we left the plant

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they were having a meeting at noon
qs.exp: Action in progress at a time.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I was work when you called.”
a: I was working when you called.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “They was waiting for the bus.”
a: They were waiting for the bus.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “While I cooked, the phone was ringing.”
a: While I was cooking, the phone rang.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “What did you doing at six?”
a: What were you doing at six?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “When he was arriving, we had dinner.”
a: When he arrived, we were having dinner.
qs.exp: Short arrival → Simple; dinner in progress → Continuous.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She wasn't listen to me.”
a: She wasn't listening to me.
She was not listening to me.

qs.q: Я писал отчёт, когда позвонил директор.
a: I was writing a report when the director called.
I was writing the report when the director called.
I was writing a report when the director phoned.
I was writing the report when the director phoned.

qs.q: Что ты делал в восемь вечера?
a: What were you doing at eight in the evening?
What were you doing at 8 pm?
What were you doing at eight pm?
What were you doing at eight o'clock in the evening?

qs.q: Пока мы ждали, пошёл дождь.
a: While we were waiting, it started to rain.
While we were waiting, it started raining.
While we were waiting, it began to rain.

qs.q: Они не работали в тот момент.
a: They weren't working at that moment.
They were not working at that moment.
They weren't working at that time.
They were not working at that time.

qs.q: Шёл снег, когда я вышел из офиса.
a: It was snowing when I left the office.

qs.q: Она говорила по телефону всё утро.
a: She was talking on the phone all morning.
She was on the phone all morning.
She was speaking on the phone all morning.

qs.q: Когда я пришёл, все разговаривали.
a: When I arrived, everybody was talking.
When I came, everybody was talking.
When I arrived, everyone was talking.
When I came, everyone was talking.
When I came in, everyone was talking.
When I came in, everybody was talking.

qs.q: Я не слышал тебя, я слушал музыку.
a: I didn't hear you, I was listening to music.
I didn't hear you. I was listening to music.
I did not hear you, I was listening to music.
